services.name: Moab ATV Tours
services.desc: Moab, Utah is a paradise for off-road enthusiasts, with its scenic trails and rugged landscapes. But before you embark on your adventure, you need to decide which type of vehicle to use: an all-terrain vehicle (ATV) or a utility terrain vehicle (UTV). Both have their pros and cons, depending on your needs and preferences. Here are some key differences between them: An ATV is a small vehicle that you ride on, not in. It has a seat that you straddle, like a motorcycle, and it is steered by handlebars. It can usually fit only one rider, although some models can accommodate two. blurb: Guests can drive their own UTV on the famous Hell’s Revenge trail, experiencing steep climbs, descents, and incredible red rock views. Alternatively, guests can enjoy a guided journey through Arches National Park in a panoramic convertible van with expert narration and short walks to key viewpoints. The company has over 16 years of experience and offers friendly, knowledgeable guides.
